description: mod-orders-storage configuration template. Default values are calibrated against a reference bugfest environment (tebfcon-mod-orders-storage revision 17, image 14.0.4); see ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file. mod-orders-storage is an RMB (Vert.x) storage module: it keeps orders data in PostgreSQL, publishes audit events to Kafka and consumes inventory and EDI export events. Resource values and JVM limits must be adjusted to the target host capacity.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-orders-storage container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-orders-storage container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-orders-storage container in MiB

java.name: xmx
java.description: Maximum Java heap size. Value taken from bugfest; with MaxMetaspaceSize it leaves under 200 MiB of the container for non-heap memory, so lower it if the container limit is reduced

java.name: MaxMetaspaceSize
java.description: Maximum Java metaspace size. Value taken from bugfest

java.name: MetaspaceSize
java.description: Threshold for the first metaspace garbage collection (not a limit). Value taken from bugfest

deployment.description: All state is in PostgreSQL and Kafka consumers share one consumer group per event type, so replicas can run side by side; the only in-memory state is short-lived settings and consortium caches. Audit outbox processing and batch tracking cleanup are triggered by mod-scheduler.

kong.description: Default Kong proxy timeouts are sufficient for storage CRUD, batch and search endpoints.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database host

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database port

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database username (sourced from the secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database password (sourced from the secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database name holding the per-tenant mod-orders-storage schemas

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST_READER
EnvVars.description: Optional read-replica host for read queries; used only together with DB_PORT_READER

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT_READER
EnvVars.description: Port of the read replica set in DB_HOST_READER

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST_READER_ASYNC
EnvVars.description: Optional asynchronous read-replica host; falls back to DB_HOST_READER, then DB_HOST

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT_READER_ASYNC
EnvVars.description: Port of the asynchronous read replica set in DB_HOST_READER_ASYNC

EnvVars.name: DB_SERVER_PEM
EnvVars.description: PEM certificate of the PostgreSQL server; when set, connections use TLSv1.3 with full verification

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum connections per tenant pool. Value taken from bugfest; RMB default is 4

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXSHAREDPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: When set, all tenants share one pool of this size instead of per-tenant pools of DB_MAXPOOLSIZE

EnvVars.name: DB_CONNECTIONRELEASEDELAY
EnvVars.description: Idle time in milliseconds before a pooled connection is closed (RMB default)

EnvVars.name: DB_MAX_LIFETIME
EnvVars.description: Maximum lifetime of a pooled connection in milliseconds (RMB default)

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of reconnect attempts when a database connection cannot be established (Vert.x default 0)

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTINTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Interval in milliseconds between database reconnect attempts (Vert.x default)

EnvVars.name: DB_EXPLAIN_QUERY_THRESHOLD
EnvVars.description: Queries slower than this many milliseconds are logged with EXPLAIN ANALYZE. Value taken from bugfest; RMB default is 1000

EnvVars.name: DB_ALLOW_SUPPRESS_OPTIMISTIC_LOCKING
EnvVars.description: ISO-8601 timestamp until which clients may bypass optimistic locking (_version) on purchase orders, order lines and pieces; unset means never

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_HOST
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker host for audit event publishing and inventory / EDI export event consumers

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PORT
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker port

EnvVars.name: REPLICATION_FACTOR
EnvVars.description: Replication factor for Kafka topics created by this module. Value taken from bugfest; module default is 1

EnvVars.name: MAX_REQUEST_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Kafka producer max.request.size in bytes (module default)

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PRODUCER_TENANT_COLLECTION
EnvVars.description: Enables tenant collection topics ({ENV}.Default.{value}.{EVENT}); must match [A-Z][A-Z0-9]{0,30} and be the same across modules. Value taken from bugfest; unset means per-tenant topics

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables folio-kafka-wrapper filtering of consumed records by tenant entitlement (library default)

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_TENANT_DISABLED_STRATEGY
EnvVars.description: Handling of records for a tenant without entitlement (ACCEPT, SKIP, FAIL). Applies when KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_ENABLED is true

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_ALL_TENANTS_DISABLED_STRATEGY
EnvVars.description: Handling of records when no tenant is entitled (ACCEPT, SKIP, FAIL). Applies when KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_ENABLED is true

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_ENTITLEMENT_REFRESH_INTERVAL_SECONDS
EnvVars.description: Interval in seconds for refreshing the tenant entitlement list. Applies when KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_ENABLED is true

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_ENTITLEMENT_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
EnvVars.description: Timeout in seconds for a tenant entitlement lookup. Applies when KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_ENABLED is true

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Logical deployment name used as the Kafka topic prefix; must match the other modules

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL (the module's sidecar on Eureka) for tenant entitlement lookups; used only when KAFKA_TENANT_FILTER_ENABLED is true

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options read by the run-java.sh entrypoint of the folioci base image (heap sizing from the java block; -Dhttp.port overrides the default port 8081, which must match the sidecar's MODULE_URL)

EnvVars.name: LOG4J_CONFIGURATION_FILE
EnvVars.description: Location of an external Log4j2 configuration overriding the bundled log4j2.properties

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the sidecar container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the sidecar container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the sidecar container in MiB

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Deployment environment identifier; must match the module's ENV

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: JVM options for the sidecar process: the java block sizing plus -Dquarkus.http.host=0.0.0.0 and -Djava.util.logging.manager=org.jboss.logmanager.LogManager, as on bugfest

EnvVars.name: MODULE_NAME
EnvVars.description: Name of the backend module the sidecar fronts

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Internal URL (host:port) at which the mod-orders-storage container is reachable from its sidecar

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Version of the mod-orders-storage module deployed alongside this sidecar

EnvVars.name: ALLOW_CROSS_TENANT_REQUESTS
EnvVars.description: Allows requests whose tenant differs from the token's tenant; needed in consortium (ECS) deployments, where inventory events from member tenants are handled with central tenant calls. Value taken from bugfest
